patterns.patternClaims: These are leads, not verified operator or automation labels.

localBrowserControl.scope: Agent-operated in-app browser using two loopback hostnames. Does not establish the cause of any historical row. The initial single-threaded test server blocked a second connection; the corrected threaded run supplied both observations.

classificationReplay.scope: Reapply current rules to the recorded declaration category and request facts only; unavailable raw User-Agent is not reconstructed. This checks rule agreement, not true operator identity.

conclusion.attributionStatus: The current counter reports request/page observations with supplied referrer evidence. This cohort cannot be authenticated as search clicks or exhaustively divided into own tests, automation and genuine Google arrivals.

sources.supports: Search clicks and Web text search type are scoped Google-side metrics.
Privacy removes rare query rows, while unfiltered chart totals include anonymized queries; time boundaries matter.
Property-level click deduplication differs from counting destination requests.
Session history stores request referrer and reuses it when fetching a history entry.
Fetch Metadata describes request context; none is a user-agent-initiated context, not a bot label.
Referer describes the source URI and can be omitted or minimized.
A non-browser HTTP client can choose the Referer field.
